system.flavor:
Jam a lock so the key will not turn, wedge a hinge so a door sticks, loosen the buckle on a saddle strap, or work a blade into the seam of a chest. One lock, one door, one strap.

Not enough to break through, only to make it stick or slip when it matters.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and suppress 1 point of its equipment Fortitude against your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move 1 unit around the target after the attack.
Suppress that point against the next attack by any creature instead.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When this target gains cover before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after its movement ends.
